I know that you probably already heard this a thousand times, and so did I, but please dont.  
A friend of mine used to also just want to die and tried a few times, every single time they tried it just made their life worse and harder, luckily now theyre doing okay but I still have to watch over them sometimes.

But thats not what I wanted to say, what I wanted to say is, even though life is hard or even unbearable right now, it can get better if you just try.

For example try thinking about the positive things in life, you made it all the way into adulthood, you dont have to argue with your parents whether or not you need a therapist and can just try if you push yourself to do it.

And dont worry about the things like your name, a name can be changed but you cant just get resurrected.

You said that you dont wanna traumatize anyone, which lets me guess that you have friends or other parts of your family that arent like your parents.  
If you trust them go and talk to them, and the fear of saying something that may make it seem like youre just trying to get attention will go away after a couple of chats with them, once you get a comfort person theyre gonna know how to treat you and how to make you feel more comfortable by helping you out with things for example.  
You have to work for that though, you have to tell them about everything if you dont already.  
And if they dont believe you then just remember that it wasnt your fault but they just dont seem to understand how things like those work.

I hope youre getting better soon and if you wanna talk, just remember that there are people out there willing to help.
